reason: Official OS Open Linked Identifiers establishes authoritative UPRN↔TOID relationships and explicitly supports linking address data to building footprints, materially improving the identifier-binding route. However this public no-login source window does not expose the project's canonical_parcel_id values/polygons or a canonical_parcel_id↔UPRN mapping; therefore no canonical parcel can yet be bound deterministically to a building footprint and accepted.
